description: REPLACE a recording's transcript with content you author (needs the 'ingest' scope). Call get_transcript first and pass its revision so a concurrent owner/agent edit cannot be overwritten. Use it to fix a bad speech-to-text pass, translate, or enrich a silent agent capture after upload. The summary regenerates from the new text automatically. Provenance is explicit: the transcript is marked as agent-edited, never passed off as speech-to-text.

expectedRevision.description: Revision from the transcript you read with get_transcript.

id.description: The recording's public id (the slug in its share URL, e.g. 'a1b2c3d4e5f6') or the full https://clipy.online/video/<id> URL.

plaintext.description: Whole transcript as one text block (stored as a single segment).

segments.description: Timestamped segments. Provide this OR plaintext.

name: replace_transcript
